Russia intensifies strikes on Ukraine; fuel crisis deepens

Russia launched over 120 drones and 12 missiles in overnight attacks across Ukraine, killing at least six people, including a child, and wounding dozens. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russian strikes targeted densely populated areas, including schools and offices in Zaporizhzhia. Meanwhile, Russia is urging remote work in its Novosibirsk region due to a deepening fuel crisis, exacerbated by Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries, including one in Omsk. Russia has also banned diesel exports, further impacting global supply.
